### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `Samples/Workbench/README.md` holds the repeatable commands that made the sample project; `PROJECT=Samples/Workbench/Workbench.uproject tools/ue/build.sh` exits 0 on 5.8.4 (log tail pasted)
- [ ] `grep -rli -e umbrella -e owl Samples/Workbench` prints nothing (exit 1): synthetic objects only (moving boxes, a spawner, a damage volume), no game content before the start (GDD B §12)
- [ ] Feature flags come from one data asset in the `docs/feature-manifest.json` shape and load at scenario reset: three synthetic flags, B requires A, C conflicts with A [VERIFY data asset load on 5.8.4]
- [ ] `PROJECT=Samples/Workbench/Workbench.uproject TEST_FILTER=Workbench tools/ue/test.sh` prints PASS with `Workbench.Flags.RequiresBlockedWithReason`, `Workbench.Flags.ConflictNeedsReset`, `Workbench.Flags.ChangeAppliesAtReset` and `Workbench.Reset.ClearsSpawnedAndTimers` (0 spawned objects and 0 active timers after one reset), pasted
- [ ] A planted flag that requires an unknown ID makes `Workbench.Flags.ManifestResolves` FAIL once (pasted), then the plant is removed
- [ ] Every event logs one line with frame, source ID, target ID and run ID (GDD B §4), 3 lines pasted
- [ ] All workbench code sits inside `#if UMBRELLAELLA_WORKBENCH` (D-new-workbench-debug) so card 0.27 ports it as is: a sample build with the switch at 0 compiles and its log has no `WORKBENCH_ON` line; at 1 it logs `WORKBENCH_ON debug=1` (both pasted)
- [ ] The sample is listed in `docs/pre-jam-declaration.md`

### Budget and cut tier

120 min agent + 60 min human, MVP
